name: 70615 · Lake Charles, LA
findings: ZIP 70615 (Lake Charles) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70615 (Lake Charles) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 70615 (Lake Charles) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).
